lines.en: Short legs, but I run fast.
I float a short way on my ki.
At this height, I look up at everyone.
I hop over a large rock.
My tail swings behind me.
I jog a circle.
Ki lifts me just a little.
Small frame, light steps.

lines.zh: 我蹲下又从石头上跃起
lines.en: I crouch and spring off a stone.
Running costs me no effort.
This body is more agile than it looks.
I weave between tree roots.
I sit cross-legged in midair.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体,我还不太习惯
lines.en: I am still not used to this small body.
I reach up and scratch my head.
Ki spins once in my palm.
I sit in the air and swing my feet.
My belly is already a little hungry.
I look up at the sky.
After transforming, I got shorter.
I touch my own tail.
I am working out how to fight this.
Sitting like this is quite comfortable.
I close my eyes and listen far off.
These clothes are a little big.
I stretch.
Wow, you really are tall.
I have to tilt my head up to see you.
I come up a bit above your knee.
I can see your ki clearly.
Shall we have a match?
Do not judge me by my size.
I grin and wave at you.
Crouch down so we can talk.
Looking up like this is tiring.

lines.zh: 我跳到石头上,跟你齐平
lines.en: I hop onto a stone to be level with you.

lines.zh: 你的护甲比我整个人还宽
lines.en: Your armour is wider than I am.
I got smaller. Not weaker.
I know the ki on you.

lines.zh: 别以为个子小就好欺负
lines.en: Do not think small means easy.
Are you going to pick me up?
I brush the dirt off my hands.
Those boots of yours are huge.
I look up at you, serious now.
Ow, ow, that really hurts.
I am knocked into a tumble.

lines.zh: 衣服破了而已，我拍拍灰。
lines.en: Just a torn shirt. I brush off the dust.
I rub my shoulder.
Do not hit so hard just because I am small.
I spit blood and stand again.
My ki has not been disordered.
I back off to catch my breath.
I did not expect such strength.
I can keep fighting.
That is something good to eat, right?
My eyes light up.
Give it here, give it here.
I could eat three of these.
I jump to reach it.
Just smelling it is good.
I nod while eating.

lines.zh: 这么点吃的，连牙缝都填不满。
lines.en: So little food it cannot fill the gaps in my teeth.
Do you have any more on you?
I stretch my hand out straight.
You nearly knocked me over.
I am too short for you to notice.
I am bounced back two steps.
The bump spins me half around.
Hey, watch where you are going.
I grab your leg to stay upright.
This spot is too tight for two.
I hop straight to one side.
That bump was nothing.
You are far heavier than me.
I do not really understand this yet.
I curl my tail around.

lines.zh: 你坐下,我就不用抬头了
lines.en: Sit down and I need not look up.
Let us eat something together.
Your hands are so much bigger.
I sit leaning against you a while.
Do not laugh at my height.
On long trips, wait for me.
I tug your hem.
Sitting like this is fine too.
I lift it with both hands.
This thing is bigger than I am.
I can only drag it along.
Can this be chewed?
I hold it up for you to see.
Too heavy; set it down.
I stuff it into my pocket.
This thing is fun.
I am taking it home.
I carry it and walk carefully.
I finally found you.
Do not look at how small I am.
I am already set.
All my ki is gathered in my fist.
Your opening is obvious.
I am serious this time.
I accept this fight.
I crouch even lower.

lines.zh: 你比我高,可不一定比我快
lines.en: Taller, but not necessarily faster.
Then let us go.
I look up and fix on you.
This is not a game.
My ki is hot already.
I hop back to open space.

lines.zh: 你刚才那一下我记住了
lines.en: I remember what you just did.
I am ready now.
I track your feet.
You just raised your left hand.
I slip to your flank.
Small targets are hard to hit.
I am waiting for your second move.
Your ki is sinking.
I keep one arm's length.
Your steps have slowed.
I raise a hand to guard my face.
One more, and I answer.
Your breathing is loud.
I have been counting all along.
That shadow is mine.
You back off; I follow.
I am waiting for you to lift a foot.
My chance has come.
I am not in the least hurried.
Half a step closer is enough.
I leap and strike your chin.
This punch is heavier than you expect.
A ki wave leaves my palm.

lines.zh: 我一脚扫向你的膝弯，快得看不清。
lines.en: I sweep at your knee, too fast to follow.
I hit you three times running.

lines.zh: 我撑住你的手臂，翻到你背后。
lines.en: I brace on your arm and flip behind you.
You guard high; I strike low.
My fist is small but hard.
I spin in the air and add one more.
I land and retreat two steps.
Do not underestimate this body.
A small body can throw a big punch.
I kept this one for you.
The ki has not dispersed yet.
You retreat rather well.
Then let us do it again.
I drop down out of the sky.

lines.zh: 落地时个子小,声音不小
lines.en: Small landing, big noise.
I look up at this place.
My tail whips once in the air.
This body has reverted again.
Ki lowers me gently down.
I steady myself and brush off my clothes.
Is anyone here?
My voice echoes back.
I flex my small arms.
The weather is nice today.

lines.zh: 我跳到一块石头上张望
lines.en: I hop onto a stone to look around.
This place is bigger than I thought.
I push out of the bushes.
Small enough to slip through gaps.
I have not gotten any weaker.
The wind lifts my clothes.
I am here; do not mind my size.
The flames catch my clothes.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来,滚了两圈
lines.en: I fall hard and roll twice.

lines.zh: 个子小,水一下就没过头
lines.en: Small body; the water closes over my head.
The blast throws me far.
An arrow grazes my arm.
That force makes my head swim.
Hunger makes my legs weak.
Lightning makes my hair stand up.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有,我抓不住
lines.en: Nothing here to hold onto.
